observations: fabro_runs_list returned zero develop runs, so the in-flight guard was a clean no-op (no degraded mode)

The ~7KB truncation originates at the provider/pebble output cap (node max_tokens unset → default), not in fabro's own code; the seed's fix must therefore be repair/persistence-side, which the brief reflects

Pre-existing environmental test failure in fabro-workflow (run 01M2DXVAJBY1XBWBSNKNG0M6DM): `git_integration::run_identity_governs_engine_and_workflow_commits_everywhere` fails because the container's global git identity is `fabro-denkhaus[bot]` while the test asserts the `fabro-sh[bot]` default — reproduced on the untouched tree via stash; the deterministic tester gate will hit it too unless its environment pins the identity

A truncated outer JSON object still contains complete inner objects, so validating the last-parsable candidate misreports truncation as a schema error (or silently accepts a partial payload against permissive schemas) — truncation must be classified before candidate scanning
